label: Extron OCS 100W
category: Control Systems / IP Link Control Proc

_avail.notes: [AVAIL] dims from Extron specifications; [AVAIL] ports, category, voltage and thermalBtuh from proposals by claude@avail.invalid (AI Assistant) accepted in the library, per the Extron OCS 100 specification 5611-D6 (voltage in the database: "24V DC (included PC 1224: from 12V DC or USB-C)"); earlier the card had a community eBUS port (Sensor Out, bus-powered): the specification shows wire leads, an SPDT relay, two sensor outputs and a 24 VDC input

ports.label: Relay (SPDT)
ports.notes: Isolated SPDT relay, 500 mA @ 24 VDC; wire leads

ports.label: Occupancy Out
ports.notes: Blue wire, occupancy only, 0-24 VDC; to a control processor digital input (Extron OCS 100 spec 5611-D6)

ports.label: Occupancy + Photocell Out
ports.notes: Gray wire, occupancy + photocell, 0-24 VDC (Extron OCS 100 spec 5611-D6)

ports.label: 24V DC In
ports.notes: Requires 24 VDC; wire leads. Use the included PC 1224 converter from 12 VDC or USB-C (TouchLink Pro)
